title: Chromosome Analysis and Sorting Using Conventional Flow Cytometers
author: Ng
materials: RPMI 1640 medium with HEPES (Gibco, cat. no. 52400‐025) supplemented with 15% FBS (Gibco, cat. no. 10270106) and antibiotics (Sigma, cat. no. G6784)
10 µg/ml KaryoMAX Colcemid (Gibco, cat. no. 15212‐012) or 10 µg/ml Demecolcine (Sigma, cat. no. D1925)
T‐75 cm2 sterile culture flasks (StemCell Technologies, cat. no. 200‐0501)
50‐ml polypropylene centrifuge tube (Greiner Bio‐one, cat no. 346370)
Fluorescence microscope with 10× to 20× objective and PI filter set (Zeiss or equivalent)

Swine fibroblast cell line (Sanger Source)DMEM/F12 medium (Gibco, cat. no. 11330057) supplemented with 15% FBS (Gibco, cat. no. 10270106) and antibiotics mixture (Sigma, cat. no. G6784)Sterile 1× PBS (Gibco, cat. no. 14190094)TrypLE Express (Gibco, cat. no. 12604013)

steps.title: Prepare 10× Polyamine Buffer
steps.instruction: In a 50‑ml Falcon tube combine 2.98 g KCl, 2.5 ml of 100 mM EGTA stock, 2.0 ml of 500 mM EDTA stock, and 7.5 ml of 1 M Tris to obtain final concentrations of 800 mM KCl, 5 mM EGTA, 20 mM EDTA, and 150 mM Tris; bring the volume to 50 ml with sterile distilled water, mix well and store at 4 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare 1× Polyamine Buffer
steps.instruction: In a new 50‑ml Falcon tube add 5 ml of the 10× PAB to 30 ml sterile distilled water, then add 25 µl of 1 M spermidine (0.5 mM final), 25 µl of 0.4 M spermine (0.2 mM final), 500 µl of 300 mM DTT (3 mM final), and 125 µl Triton X‑100 (0.25 % v/v); bring to 50 ml with sterile distilled water, rotate for 30 min, adjust pH to 7.50 with 0.5 M NaOH (verify with pH indicator paper), filter through a 0.22‑µm syringe filter, and store at 4 °C for up to 1 month. Critical: pH must be adjusted before use.

steps.title: Culture and Sub‑culture Cells
steps.instruction: For the suspension GM7016A line add 50 ml fresh growth medium to achieve ~50 % confluence and incubate 24 hr; for adherent swine fibroblasts grow to ~75 % confluence, then split 1:1 into 2–4 T‑150 cm² flasks (or for suspension lines split 1:1 into two T‑75 cm² flasks) and incubate another 24 hr before inhibitor treatment. Remove half of the old medium from suspension cultures without disturbing cell clusters before sub‑culturing.

steps.title: Treat Cells with Colcemid
steps.instruction: Add colcemid (or demecolcine) to a final concentration of 0.1 µg/ml. Incubate suspension cells for 4–6 hr and adherent cells for 6–24 hr (optimize per cell line). If excessive cell death occurs, reduce the dose or replace the inhibitor.

steps.title: Harvest Metaphase Cells and Swell
steps.instruction: Collect the colcemid‑treated cells and resuspend them in a hypotonic solution for ~15 min at room temperature. Monitor swelling by staining a small aliquot with Turck’s stain or propidium iodide (PI) under a microscope. Once swollen, pellet the cells and drain them dry on absorbent paper.

steps.title: Release Chromosomes from Swollen Cells
steps.instruction: Add the modified 1× polyamine isolation buffer (containing Triton X‑100) to the dried pellet, then disrupt the cells by vortexing or syringing. Assess the suspension by staining a small aliquot with PI and viewing under a fluorescence microscope; if clumps are observed, pass the suspension several times through a 22.5‑gauge needle attached to a 5 ml syringe to obtain single, intact chromosomes.

steps.title: Stain Chromosomes (DAPI/PI or HO/CA3)
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate fluorochromes: for the DAPI/PI protocol add DAPI and PI; for the UV/indigo protocol add Hoechst and Chromomycin A3. Incubate the stained suspension overnight (≈8 hr or longer) at 4 °C in the dark to allow complete equilibration of the dyes with DNA.

steps.title: Add Sulfite and Citrate (Optional)
steps.instruction: Add sodium sulfite and sodium citrate to the stained chromosome suspension (concentrations not specified) and incubate overnight at 4 °C in the dark. Monitor the flow‑karyotype resolution; if it deteriorates, reduce the concentration of one or both compounds or omit them.

steps.title: Acquire Flow Cytometry Data
steps.instruction: Run the sample on a BD LSR Fortessa. Apply a threshold (trigger) on the DAPI fluorescence channel to exclude non‑chromosome events. Acquire 50,000–100,000 events at a rate of 1,000 events/s. Let the sample run a few minutes until chromosomes settle and fluorescence stabilizes, then draw region gates on chromosomes of interest. Refresh acquisition for a couple of minutes if needed before saving the data.

steps.title: Purify Sorted Chromosomes
steps.instruction: Collect sorted chromosomes (≈250,000 copies per 1.5‑ml Eppendorf tube) and purify them using the described method (suitable for downstream PCR, sequencing, microarray, or other genomics assays).
